title: Guess Noun
tagline: A "Guess Who" game but with Nouns & ELO on the Attestation Station!
description:
- Simple tracked game with Commit Reveal mechanism
- ELO scores for players with revocable attestations on the Attestation Station
- Deterministic games of Guess Who using subsets of Noun Characteristics
- Offchain refereed game (need a way to for players to commit, play, and also to identify the winner!)
Work in progress!
how_its_made:
Nouns SDK & Nouns Assets pulled into frontend
Custom game generation (need sufficient overlapping characteristics)
Attestation Station v1 (forked Goerli)
ELO Lib for ELO https://github.com/saucepoint/elo-lib
Hardhat
Nexth starter kit (incl. SIWE, Signed messages etc)
Ceramic for referee storage
